events.label: Fresh Footprints Among the Dead
events.description: Living bootprints cut through a procession of skeleton tracks. The cult is only a little ahead.

events.label: A Reflection at the Far Gate
events.description: For one instant the cult leader lifts the Mirror in a distant archway. The reflection shows a crown that is not yet on his head.

events.label: The First Dead Procession
events.description: Weak skeletons and zombies stumble across the road while living robed figures disappear deeper into the city.
